grid.v1 · event explorer

Events

Every discrete occurrence the Grid tracks — wildfire, evacuation, weather alert, earthquake, road incident, and the rest — is reachable through one endpoint. The filters below map 1:1 onto the query parameters of GET /api/v1/events; results are the camelCase protojson of grid.v1.EventList, server-sorted severity-first, then newest-first. This page's whole filter state lives in its URL, so any view you compose here is a shareable permalink — you can replay the exact request yourself.
